reviews.comment: Super nice prof, but if you aren't math-savvy, take 135 instead! 140 is extremely hard and complex. There is a ton of constant homework, and the exams are brutal and worth almost your entire grade. Tutoring is available, and "Tutor John" is a lifesaver who will get you through it. Save your GPA and take 135 if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I would strongly recommend getting TSI certified instead taking this course. The professor is kind, but the teaching style relies more on stating information than explaining it, which makes it hard to follow. The structure can feel repetitive, and once you fall behind it is difficult to recover without retaking the class, which can impact your GPA.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take this class at A&M, the way this class is set up is for you to fail. All the students in her class had taken it 2 times. She wants you to dedicate basically all your time to this class which is ridiculous. There's weekly quizzes that are weighted the same as exams so if you don't do well on those, the exams will be way worse.

DO NOT TAKE Dr. Hester's class. Her class was honestly not a great experience. She kept saying “math is life” and acted as if her class should come before all our others, which just isn't realistic. I only took her to get TSI approved. She gets so frustrated when we don't answer her in class and starts to yell for no reason.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is nice as a person, but harsh as an educator. I was put in her Math 140 class with a tutor in a system to get TSI complete-ruined my semester. She would get upset with us at times when we did not understand something during her lectures, which was discouraging. It felt like unless you were perfect at math, there was no succeeding

DO NOT TAKE! terrible professor and tough grader, picky for no reason. take any other professor no matter how much work you put into the class you wont do well. Her test are all workout (including the final exam) when every single other professor gives multiple choice. Over half the class dropped.

If there is another professor, I would take them as opposed to Dr. Hester. She was a very sweet lady and helpful during office hours. However, the tests were more difficult than they needed to be and she is very picky about how you present answers and work. I put a lot of work into this course, but did not get the grade I wanted.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Hester is sweet and genuinely cares for her students. Her class isn't an easy A but it isn't hard if you have a good math background. I was nervous to claim my AP credit from high school and skip 147 but I'm glad I did. Doing the optional hw and attending class helps; tests are fair and there is 1 quiz per week but they aren't too difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Okay so i ended up dropping this class mid semester because of how hard it was. I was going to a tutor twice a week and doing all of the assignments and STILL had a hard time making a D! My tutor told me that she's the hardest prof for this class by far! Gives a weekly quiz, 3 tests and a final, & a lot of homework. It took over my life!

I was in her class for about 2 weeks and had to drop it because she wasn't able to work with me to clarify on topics I needed help with. Definitely doesn't teach the subject very well and the online homework is a NIGHTMARE! Have to retake in the spring either with a different professor or at Blinn
